solutionSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS month_start,
         CAST(COUNT(*) AS integer) AS shipments
  FROM shipments
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       shipments,
       shipments - LAG(shipments) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month_start;
ambiguities: After a month with no bookings is left out, 'the change from the previous month' is still unclear. I compute it against the previous listed month, not the previous calendar month, which would be zero. No dataset I ran has a gap, so this is not exercised.
notes: Revised text: every shipment counts, whatever its status, which is how the query already worked. Casts: shipments cast to integer (was bigint); change is integer minus integer. Month taken with booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'. Sample: 2025-12 has 46 shipments (change NULL), 2026-01 has 194 (change 148). Each dataset returned only Dec and Jan.
